title: Teodoro: China has no right to demand BRP Sierra Madre pullout

blocks.text: MANILA – Department of National Defense (DND) Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said Wednesday that China has no right to demand the removal of the BRP Sierra Madre (LS-57) from Ayungin Shoal in the West Philippine Sea. “They have no right to say that. So, it is beyond their jurisdiction and beyond any form of intervention under international law,” he said in a press briefing during the second day of the ASEAN Ministerial Conference on Disaster Resilience at Conrad Hotel in Pasay City.
